checks.name: capture files match reviewed provenance records
exact 60-second timeline; no autoplay; accessible native controls
representative desktop scenes render distinctly and deterministically
API seek clamps negative, overshoot and nonfinite values
native range keyboard and focused player keyboard seek correctly
play, pause, exact end, replay, and fullscreen controls
timestamp previews clamp and remain paused
genuine clips seek deterministically, stay silent and pause with the timeline
phone canvas reflows in portrait without overflow; controls remain usable
narrow desktop pane uses readable portrait framing with visible controls
no console errors or failed local resources

creativeChanges: Actual product graph, close-up Easy/Expert action, saved tool inspection, Continue goal and ordinary draft-memory review controls. Creative source frozen for review.
pending: Parent integration into the existing PR and required CI
previewOwnership: Parent-owned static preview; no film-owned persistent service.
notes: Supplementary clips inspect saved state and do not record new model execution.
Known imperfect temperature wording is outside the film output crops; the full evidence is preserved.

independentReview.fullMotion: Passed all acts; observed exactly 60s playback in 60.026s wall time; no creative or factual blocker.
independentReview.boundaryRecheck: Passed cold, after full playback, and replay 0.001s before each boundary; first active frames readyState 4, not seeking, within 12ms of source start; no page or media errors.

creativeReview.scope: Parent and independent critic accepted the assembled story; required switch, goal, memory and desktop resolution changes applied.
creativeReview.responsive: At 711 × 900, portrait canvas is 427.5 × 570 and player controls end at 870px; no overflow. The 390 × 844 phone and 1440 × 900 desktop layouts are preserved. Editor and Persona scenes were visually reviewed.
creativeReview.parentFinalInspection: Passed final page and continuous playback inspection: narrow-pane framing and controls visible, full timeline ends cleanly, CTA readable, and genuine UI/action crops accepted.

staticSiteCheck.scope: Current pages, local anchors/assets, CSS URLs, film capture assets and release-version contracts. No remote-link or visual claims.

syntaxAndDiffChecks: Passed five JavaScript syntax checks and git diff --check.
deliveryBoundary: Film lane does not commit, create a PR, merge or publish. Parent owns integration, CI and public delivery.

cleanup.preserved: Final poster, product MP4, reviewed source media, source files and parent-owned preview.

nextAction: Parent commits the stable film batch with the website changes in the existing PR, then completes required CI and public delivery.
sourceHashFormat: SHA-256 after normalizing CRLF to LF, so these source fingerprints also match Git checkouts and GitHub Pages. Media and artifact hashes use exact bytes.
